claim: Items stored as tile cells in a scrolling background need a shadow map fed by hooks on every routine that writes a cell, since an untracked writer leaves stale records.

evidence.text: The prototype's 58 mismatches (rainbow.rzx 2500 frames) included 16 stale records from a full-tile drawer (60839) it did not track; with it tracked 446 ok / 36 figure / 0 other; hooks at the three cell drawers feed a shadow map built at render start.
evidence.quote: item had been overwritten by the full-tile drawer 60839, which the prototype did not track;
